name: Aminata Diallo
headline: 19-year-old apprentice bricklayer and part-time student, Bamako, Mali
description: Aminata works six days a week on a construction site, learning the trade from a master mason while saving for evening classes in accounting. She lives in a rented room with no running water, and each month her income is just enough to cover food and school fees. Her cautious approach means she double-checks every measurement and keeps a small emergency fund hidden under her mattress.
